diagnostics.message: The api version beta is a label, but the surface app puts a version number in its paths.
diagnostics.fix: Write an integer version, or set pathVersion: none on every surface (or in conventions).

diagnostics.message: The prefix /v2/app of the surface app holds the literal version segment v2; the version is held once, on the api.
diagnostics.fix: Write {version} instead of v2.

diagnostics.message: The item Note of the collection notes has no property noteId to hold the member id.
diagnostics.fix: Set idProperty to the item property that holds the id, or add that property to the item.

diagnostics.message: The create op createNote has no input; the item schema holds fields a client never sends.
diagnostics.fix: Declare input on the create op.

diagnostics.message: The collection logs declares no id, so the operation at /surfaces/app/routes/logs/ops/0 in its member scope has no member path.
diagnostics.fix: Declare id on logs: its member id path parameter and schema.

diagnostics.message: The get op of drafts answers its item, but drafts declares no item.
diagnostics.fix: Declare item on drafts, or give the op an output.

diagnostics.message: The body limit 99999999999999999999MiB is larger than any size the compiler can check.
diagnostics.fix: Write a smaller bodyLimit, at most 8589934591MiB.

diagnostics.message: The query field payload of raw is an opaque value, which has no text form.
diagnostics.fix: Give it a schema with a text form, or move it into the body.

diagnostics.message: The query field payloads of batch is an opaque value, which has no text form.
diagnostics.fix: Give it a schema with a text form, or move it into the body.

diagnostics.message: The request header X-File of attached is a file, which has no text form.
diagnostics.fix: Give it a schema with a text form, or move it into the body.

diagnostics.message: The query field itemId of shadowed has the name of its path parameter, which frameworks merging both read as one value.
diagnostics.fix: Rename one of the two.

diagnostics.message: The path /rooted written for rooted starts with /; a path is relative segments.
diagnostics.fix: Write the path as segments separated by /, without / at either end, ., .., ?, # or %.

diagnostics.message: The route both writes both responses and output; responses replaces output.
diagnostics.fix: Move the output schema into a responses entry, or remove responses.

diagnostics.message: The 204 response of emptied has a body, which a 204 No Content never carries.
diagnostics.fix: Answer the body with 200, or remove the body.

diagnostics.message: The fields at /surfaces/app/routes/listed/query name Id, which is not an object schema, so it has no fields.
diagnostics.fix: Name an object schema, or write the fields as a map.

diagnostics.message: The path /vbeta/v2/app/x/{missing} of misplaced holds {missing}, which no pathParams or id declares.
diagnostics.fix: Declare missing in pathParams.

diagnostics.message: The operation twice answers GET /vbeta/v2/app/twice, which a router cannot tell from GET /vbeta/v2/app/twice of again.
diagnostics.fix: Change the path or the method of one of the two routes.

diagnostics.message: The request header x-a of twice is declared twice.
diagnostics.fix: Remove one of the two declarations.

diagnostics.message: The request header X-GitHub-Event of hook is the tag of its input union, which adds it.
diagnostics.fix: Remove the header; the union's discriminator adds it.

diagnostics.message: The 301 response of moved is a redirect, which has no body.
diagnostics.fix: Remove the body; the compiler adds the Location header.
